## 🎓 Key Learnings & Best Practices

1. **Consistent Naming**: `<Number>_<Feature>_<Type>.<Extension>`
2. **Modular Structure**: Each feature in own folder
3. **Comprehensive Documentation**: Business rules + technical details
4. **Real-World Scenarios**: Practical use cases included
5. **Developer-Friendly**: Clear examples, error handling
6. **Responsive Design**: Mobile-first approach
7. **Reusable Components**: Bootstrap components throughout
